label: Shutter screw & blade
speech: The bent shutter sits inside the chamber. Turning the top screw rotates the shutter blade above the substrate. The nuts stay fixed; they are not the operating handle. The washer and top seal also stay stationary.

label: Load the substrate
speech: The tool coats a substrate with a thin film of target material. After venting, open the door and place the substrate on the stage. The shutter is parked for access. Close the door before evacuation.

label: Shutter screw · opening
speech: This top view temporarily hides the complete gun so the shutter movement is visible. Turn the top screw to swing the blade away from the substrate. The nuts stay fixed. This opens the path from the source to the sample.

label: Shutter open · substrate coating
speech: With the shutter parked, sputtered target material reaches the substrate and builds a thin film. The source remains above the fixed stage. The shutter controls the coating interval without moving either the substrate or the gun.

label: Shutter screw · closing
speech: Turn the screw back to bring the blade over the substrate; the nuts remain stationary. Closing the shutter ends direct exposure from the source. The source is then switched off before the controlled shutdown and vent sequence.

label: Vent, open & unload
speech: After the source is off and the pumping system has completed its shutdown and vent sequence, open the door and remove the coated substrate. This completes the high-level cycle: load, evacuate, admit gas, condition, coat and unload.
